title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Backend Engineer to join our growing team. You will design and build scalable APIs, work with cloud technologies, and mentor junior developers.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement RESTful APIs using FastAPI or Django
- Optimize database queries and caching strategies
- Deploy and manage services on AWS
- Collaborate with frontend teams and product managers
- Mentor junior engineers and conduct code reviews

Requirements:
- 5+ years of Python development experience
- Strong experience with FastAPI or Django
- Proficiency with PostgreSQL or similar databases
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- AWS cloud experience (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Strong communication and leadership skills

Nice to have:
- Experience with microservices architecture
- Knowledge of Redis and caching
- CI/CD pipeline experience
